summary: Sony Group Corp filed a Form 6-K reporting the status of its ongoing share repurchase program, authorized by the Board on May 8, 2026, for up to 230 million shares (3.89% of outstanding) for up to ¥500 billion. Between May 11-31, 2026, it repurchased 19,069,900 shares for ¥67.26 billion via open-market purchases on the Tokyo Stock Exchange under a discretionary contract. The program runs through May 10, 2027. This is the issuer returning capital to shareholders through buybacks, not an M&A event. Watch future periodic repurchase updates for cumulative progress against the authorized ceiling.
